cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

mechanism: A corrects a witness's compressed chronology to reconstruct whether the bag returned to the bus.
confusable: General form-filling lacks D126's comparison and retesting; S03 must insist on a usable sequence.
comparison: A hurried trip with a driver differs from comparing the physical layers of parcel packaging.
seedUse: Use the bus/café overlap and an interrupted coffee purchase as new information to test the bag movement.
